shortDescription: Module for setup of ApplicationPersistenceProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: app_cookie_persistence_profile
options.description: Specifies the application cookie persistence profile parameters.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: User defined description for the object.

options.name: hdr_persistence_profile
options.description: Specifies the custom http header persistence profile parameters.

options.name: http_cookie_persistence_profile
options.description: Specifies the http cookie persistence profile parameters.

options.name: ip_persistence_profile
options.description: Specifies the client ip persistence profile parameters.

options.name: is_federated
options.description: This field describes the object's replication scope. If the field is set to false, then the object is visible within the controller-cluster and its associated service-engines. If the field is set to true, then the object is replicated across the federation. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: name
options.description: A user-friendly name for the persistence profile.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: persistence_type
options.description: Method used to persist clients to the same server for a duration of time or a session. Enum options - PERSISTENCE_TYPE_CLIENT_IP_ADDRESS, PERSISTENCE_TYPE_HTTP_COOKIE, PERSISTENCE_TYPE_TLS, PERSISTENCE_TYPE_CLIENT_IPV6_ADDRESS, PERSISTENCE_TYPE_CUSTOM_HTTP_HEADER, PERSISTENCE_TYPE_APP_COOKIE, PERSISTENCE_TYPE_GSLB_SITE. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as PERSISTENCE_TYPE_CLIENT_IP_ADDRESS.

options.name: server_hm_down_recovery
options.description: Specifies behavior when a persistent server has been marked down by a health monitor. Enum options - HM_DOWN_PICK_NEW_SERVER, HM_DOWN_ABORT_CONNECTION, HM_DOWN_CONTINUE_PERSISTENT_SERVER. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as HM_DOWN_PICK_NEW_SERVER.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the persistence profile.
